### Embark Upon a Thrilling Journey
Explore a land with diverse landscapes, ecologies, and weather, as well as a realistic day/night cycle. The v1.0 release of Myth of Empires also features a new map – Dongzhou Island, offering new adventures and challenges.
### Build Your Own Empire From the Ground Up
Myth of Empires features sandbox gameplay with a high degree of freedom; the game has 1300+ different crafting recipe, allowing you to build your own empire. The v1.0 release adds new recipes, including mechanical tools and base defenses, as well as a new planting system. The possibilities are endless.
### Recruit NPCs, Tame Wildlife
In-depth taming and training systems allow players to recruit or subdue additional forces to aid them in combat and production. The v1.0 release adds new boss NPCs and powerful beasts. In addition, smaller types of animals can be used to help power your base’s defenses.
### Wage Epic Wars on Ancient Battlefields
Myth of Empires features hundreds of different weapons, armor, and large-scale engineering equipment. Pick the weapons that best suit your playstyle, or utilize your strategic capabilities to build an army. The v1.0 release introduces powerful mechanical base defenses, wooden oxen, and other new combat equipment to further enrich the game’s deep war experience.
### Engage in Cross-server Battles
Establish administrative regions, fight for the position of county magistrate, and compete to expand your territory through Fortress Battles. Craft the perfect guild and utilize your diplomatic prowess to ensure its long-term stability.
### Write Your Own Legend
With 25 different development paths, a 16-level title system, and more than 100 achievements, you have complete freedom in growing your character. Become a legendary military commander, or content yourself with the life of a simple farmer – the choice is yours.

### Plains
The open flatlands are rich in plant resources, low level animals and NPCs. The terrain here is easy to navigate, it is the perfect training place for beginners, but it can be difficult to hide your base here.
### Swamp
Plagued with Miasma and venomous bugs, this kind of wetland is one of the most dangerous habitats in the world. However, the availability of bugs and high level plant resources here makes this place a popular destination for explorers. Bring a censer, at least then you can breathe.
### Rainforest
Extremely rich in fauna and flora. The thick vegetation makes riding and vehicle travel difficult, but it does make hiding easy, which is why this can be an ideal location for beginners.
### Alpine
In the snow covered land of the extreme cold, where only Fir Trees can survive the blizzards. The mines here contain the most precious mineral resources in the world. Pay attention to keeping warm when you exploring here.
### Gobi
An extremely hot arid region, only Poplar Trees and a few shrubs grow here. The False Daisy is a precious plant that is unique to this habitat. Remember to bring an Ice Container to cool down and beware of dust storms.
### Mountains
Although the mountains make transportation difficult, they can become a natural barrier of defense. With relatively rich resources, they can meet the daily needs of novice players and can become a very popular area.

## Compete for a Share of $10,000! Myth of Empires S4 Season Rules Revealed!
When the Xizhou Civilization DLC launches on March 21, the flames of battle in Myth of Empires S4 Season will reignite!  
All players across the servers can join this ultimate showdown. Be sure to carefully review the detailed S4 Season rules and prepare for war!
This season, we’ve prepared an unprecedented surprise for the victors—**a massive $10,000 prize pool!** Who will rise above the fierce competition and claim a spot in the top 10? Let’s find out!
At the same time, the Myth of Empires Celebration Event will kick off, bringing an array of exciting content! Enjoy a limited-time 30% discount across the official shop, and check out the stunning new Lu Bu and Zhang Fei skins, adding a unique flair to your characters. Don’t miss out!
**S4 Season Basic Information**
**1. Season Duration**
March 21, 2025, 14:00 UTC — June 23, 2025, 00:00 UTC
**2. Explanation for S4 Season Cash Rewards**
  1. After the season ends, the top 10 guilds will be determined based on the rankings calculated by the system.
  2. Rewards will be distributed to the top 10 guild leaders, who will allocate the prizes at their discretion. (After the season ends, if a change in the guild leader occurs, the rewards will still be given to the leader as of the season’s conclusion.)
  3. After the season ends, the official announcement will be made, and guild leaders of the top 10 will be notified via in-game mail. They will also be informed of how to claim the cash rewards. Guild leaders are advised to keep an eye on the system mail in the game at that time.
**3. Prize Distribution**
!
**4. S4 Season Rules**
Compared to S3 Season, the duration of the S4 season will be extended to 3 months. The adjustments and differences from the previous season are as follows：
  1. Higher copper coin drop rates
  2. A significant increase in honor acquisition multiplier
  3. The Beast Lord’s health has been appropriately reduced
  4. Increased damage of the Heavy Ballista to buildings and vehicles
  5. Increased respawn time for the Beast Lord and large mounts on the battlefield
  6. A significant increase in the drop rate for DLC-related bosses
  7. New advanced rewards added to the Tally Order: Bag of Divine Strength (Increases carry weight by 50% for 30 days)
Below are the detailed settings：
!
**Xizhou Civilization DLC Launch Celebration Event**
Event Duration: March 21, 2025, 14:00 UTC — March 28, 2025, 00:00 UTC
**Kongming Lantern Event**
This event is only available on non-seasonal servers.
  1. During the event, Kongming Lanterns will randomly drop from the sky across the entire map. Players can predict where the lanterns will fall and head to those locations in advance. The lanterns will contain various in-game items.
  2. There is a chance to obtain a Cloud-piercing Arrow from the Kongming Lantern. When using a bow and arrow to shoot the Cloud-piercing Arrow into the sky, an additional Kongming Lantern will be summoned in the current area.
**County Blessing Event**
  1. **Non-seasonal servers:** Gathering output +100% (Stone, Plants, Animals), Taming multiplier +100% (Warriors and Mounts)
  1. **Seasonal servers:** When crafting Wotou and arrows, there is a 33% chance to receive an additional 100% single-item yield.
**7-Day Login Rewards**
Each day, rewards will be sent to each player via in-game mail.
**Official Shop Celebration Event**
Event Duration: March 20, 2025, 17:00 UTC — April 3, 2025, 17:00 UTC
  1. All items in shop are available at a limited-time 30% discount.
  2. Newly launched Three Kingdoms Mighty Generals mystery box (including new skins for Lu Bu and Zhang Fei).
  3. Newly launched Xizhou Civilization DLC building skin mystery box.
  4. Limited-time Jade Ring Exchange: Exchange for popular skins such as the Dragon Falchion, Crimson Sheen Blade, Gentian Silver Spear, and Golden Lion Spear.

## Myth of Empires Xizhou Civilization DLC introduces the Aerial Fortress, the airborne dominator that reshapes the battlefield.
Myth of Empires Xizhou Civilization DLC is now in the final countdown and will officially launch on March 21 at 02:00 UTC, with servers going live at 14:00 UTC the same day. This DLC is packed with content, including previously revealed exciting features and a game-changing surprise—the Aerial Fortress. This colossal airborne behemoth will reshape the battlefield, becoming a decisive force in the hands of players to turn the tide of war.
!
This is a costly airborne mobile platform and a meticulously crafted strategic weapon. Flying higher than a giant Kongming lantern, it provides a commanding aerial view of the battlefield. With a fortress defense level of 75 and enhanced durability, it truly lives up to the name Aerial Fortress. However, its massive size comes with drawbacks—relatively slow movement speed and limited maneuverability, making quick turns difficult. In the ever-changing tides of battle, this could be a significant weakness.
In terms of functionality, the Aerial Fortress is not only capable of supporting structures but also allows players to equip it with various siege weapons, including Heavy Ballista, Mechanical Crossbow, Repeating Crossbow, and Counterweight Trebuchet. While airborne, it can launch attacks on targets below. However, for balance reasons, the number of weapons that can be mounted is strictly limited.
In the upcoming Xizhou map, the striking Yadan landforms will draw countless adventurers to explore. These towering wind-eroded pillars, with broad tops and narrow bases, are prime locations for many guilds to establish their strongholds. Their natural terrain advantages make them nearly inaccessible by land, leaving enemy forces with no choice but to watch from afar. In this scenario, the Aerial Fortress becomes the ultimate siege weapon. In PVP mode, its arrival will disrupt the traditional ground-based warfare, enabling high-altitude assaults that strike deep into enemy territory, delivering devastating blows and completely reshaping the battlefield dynamics.
Of course, the Aerial Fortress is not invincible. In the game's battlefield ecosystem, watchtowers and ballista serve as effective counters, especially when attacks precisely hit the balloon on top of the Aerial Fortress, dealing triple damage and inflicting significant damage.
With the upcoming update to the Xizhou Civilization DLC, the powerful addition of the Aerial Fortress will undoubtedly inject new vitality into the game, offering players an unprecedented fresh experience. On March 21, we look forward to stepping into the new world of Myth of Empires together, embarking on an unforgettable journey of exploration and conquest!

## March 21 2025 – Myth of Empires New Server Launch Announcement
Dear Players,
We plan to launch new Prefectures and Counties following the version update on March 21, 2025 for Myth of Empires. The existing territory under the New Era world will be designated as [Territory 1], while a brand-new parallel [Territory 2] will be introduced.
Server Launch Plan – March 21, 2025, at 14:00 (UTC)  
Territory 1: A new county for the Xizhou Map will be opened, accessible to players who own the Xizhou Civilization DLC.  
Territory 2: Additional new counties will be introduced across Zhongzhou, Dongzhou, and the Xizhou Maps. For the first 180 days, Territory 1 and Territory 2 will remain independent, with separate guilds, alliances, and trading post. After 180 days, cross-server access will be enabled.
New Era – Territory 1  
At 14:00 (UTC) on March 21, new Xizhou Map counties will be opened in:  
Prefecture 70, Prefecture 10, Prefecture 55, Prefecture 47, Prefecture 20, and Prefecture 28.  
Additionally, based on server load after launch, more counties may be opened in:  
Prefecture 8, Prefecture 12, Prefecture 64, and Prefecture 27.
Jade Era   
At 14:00 (UTC) on March 21, new Xizhou Map counties will be opened in:  
Prefecture 19 and Prefecture 20.  
Additional counties may be opened in:  
Prefecture 19 and Prefecture 20, depending on server load.
New Era – Territory 2  
At 14:00 (UTC) on March 21, new counties will be opened in:  
Prefecture 19, Prefecture 45, Prefecture 43, Prefecture 70, Prefecture 20, Prefecture 28, Prefecture 55, Prefecture 47, and Prefecture 62 across the Zhongzhou, Dongzhou, and Xizhou Maps.  
Additional counties may be opened in:  
Prefecture 18, Prefecture 10, Prefecture 8, Prefecture 12, Prefecture 29, Prefecture 27, Prefecture 21, and Prefecture 61, based on server load.
Additionally, the S4 Season Server will launch simultaneously. Players, please prepare for battle!
